title: 第9章 白骨牢笼众矢之的第10章 恨火淬魂戮宴初尝
slug: 噬主成魔万魂幡饮血开锋
content_zh:
万魂幡散发的暗金光晕如同残破的君王冠冕，笼罩着阴九幽摇摇欲坠的残躯。
白骨战场死寂无声，唯有秘境本源溃散后的精纯怨煞如涓涓细流，缓缓滋养着他破碎的经脉与濒临崩溃的万魂幡。
胸腹间那道狰狞的“蜈蚣”
伤口贪婪地汲取着力量，翻涌的黑气愈发粘稠深邃，透着一股令人心悸的邪异。
然而，这片刻的喘息，注定短暂。
轰隆隆——！
整个白骨秘境并未因意志核心的破碎而彻底平静，反而像是失去了主心骨的巨兽，开始了更加无序、更加狂暴的崩溃！
大地如同破碎的蛋壳，巨大的裂缝疯狂蔓延，深不见底，喷涌出粘稠如墨、带着刺骨阴寒的死气浊流！
天空铅灰色的死气阴云彻底狂暴，形成无数个大小不一的、相互吞噬的漩涡，将散落的血色光雨撕扯、湮灭！
空间本身变得极其脆弱，扭曲的光线中，一道道不稳定的空间裂缝如同贪婪的巨口，时隐时现！
“不好…空间…崩塌！”
阴九幽吞噬漩涡般的眼眸猛地收缩。
他虽重创了秘境意志，但也彻底引爆了这片古战场积累万年的怨煞死气，引发了连锁崩塌！
他必须立刻离开！
否则将被这空间乱流彻底撕碎、湮灭，万魂幡再强也护不住！
他强提一口魂元，试图沟通万魂幡，寻找空间薄弱点强行突破。
就在这千钧一发之际！
“咻！
咻！
咻！”

数道凌厉无匹、带着贪婪与毁灭气息的攻击，毫无征兆地从数个方向撕裂混乱的能量乱流，狠狠轰向正在竭力稳定身形的阴九幽！
一道炽热的赤红刀芒，带着焚山煮海的威势！
一道阴柔歹毒的碧绿毒针，无声无息，直刺后心！
还有一道厚重的土黄色拳印，封锁了所有闪避空间！
每一击，都蕴含着至少筑基中期以上的恐怖威能！
而且配合默契，时机歹毒，正是阴九幽旧力刚去、新力未生，又身处空间崩塌险境的绝杀时刻！
“什么人？！”
阴九幽心中警兆狂鸣！
他强行扭转身躯，白骨幡杆横扫，万魂幡虚影仓促护体！
轰！
轰！
噗嗤！
赤红刀芒与土黄拳印被白骨幡杆和幡影勉强震偏，但那道阴险的碧绿毒针却穿透了防御间隙，狠狠钉入了他本就残破的左肩！
一股歹毒无比的腐蚀剧毒瞬间爆发，疯狂侵蚀他的血肉魂元！
“呃！”
阴九幽闷哼一声，身体踉跄后退，左肩伤口瞬间变得乌黑溃烂，剧痛钻心！
万魂幡也剧烈动荡。
三道身影如同鬼魅般，从混乱的空间乱流和崩塌的骸骨堆中浮现。
为首一人，身着赤红法袍，面容阴鸷，手持一柄燃烧着烈焰的长刀，正是赤焰刀客——
焚心老祖！

他贪婪地盯着阴九幽手中的万魂幡，舔了舔嘴唇：“好浓郁的魂煞本源！
还有一丝王魂气息！
content_en:
The dark golden halo emitted by the Ten Thousand Souls Banner is like a broken king's crown, shrouding Yin Jiuyou's crumbling body.
The battlefield of bones was silent, and only the pure resentment after the collapse of the secret realm was like a trickle, slowly nourishing his broken meridians and the Ten Thousand Soul Banner that was on the verge of collapse.
The ferocious "centipede" between the chest and abdomen
The wound greedily absorbed strength, and the surging black energy became thicker and thicker, revealing a heart-stopping evil.
However, this moment of respite is destined to be short-lived.
Rumble——!
The entire Secret Realm of Bones was not completely calm due to the shattering of the core of will. Instead, it seemed like a giant beast that had lost its backbone, and began to collapse more disorderly and violently!
The earth is like a broken eggshell, with huge cracks spreading crazily and bottomlessly, spewing out a stream of deathly air that is as thick as ink and carries biting coldness!
The lead-gray death clouds in the sky were completely violent, forming countless vortexes of different sizes that devoured each other, tearing apart and annihilating the scattered bloody light rain!
The space itself has become extremely fragile. In the distorted light, unstable space cracks appear and disappear like greedy giant mouths!
"Not good...space...collapses!"
Yin Jiuyou's swallowing whirlpool eyes suddenly shrank.
Although he severely damaged the will of the secret realm, he also completely detonated the resentment and death energy accumulated in this ancient battlefield for thousands of years, triggering a chain collapse!
He must leave immediately!
Otherwise, it will be completely torn apart and annihilated by the turbulent currents in this space. No matter how strong the Ten Thousand Soul Flag is, it will not be able to protect it!
He forcefully took a mouthful of soul energy, tried to communicate with the Ten Thousand Soul Flags, and found a weak point in the space to force a breakthrough.
At this critical moment!
"Phew!
Phew!
Phew! "
Several extremely fierce attacks, carrying the aura of greed and destruction, tore apart the chaotic energy flow from several directions without warning, and slammed into Yin Jiuyou who was trying his best to stabilize his body!
A blazing red sword light carried the power of burning mountains and boiling seas!
A soft and vicious green poisonous needle pierced the back of the heart silently!
There is also a thick khaki fist seal that blocks all dodge space!
Every strike contains terrifying power that is at least in the middle stage of foundation building!
Moreover, the cooperation is tacit and the timing is vicious. It is the decisive moment when Yin Jiuyou's old power has just gone, but his new power has not yet emerged, and he is in danger of space collapse!
"Who?!"
Warning signs screamed in Yin Jiuyou's heart!
He forcibly twisted his body, the bone flag pole swept across, and the shadow of the Ten Thousand Soul Flags hurriedly protected his body!
boom!
boom!
Poof!
The red sword light and earthy yellow fist mark were barely deflected by the white bone flag pole and flag shadow, but the insidious green poisonous needle penetrated the defense gap and nailed his already broken left shoulder!
An extremely vicious corrosive poison erupted instantly, eroding his flesh, flesh, and soul like crazy!
"Ugh!"
Yin Jiuyou groaned and staggered back. The wound on his left shoulder instantly turned black and festered, causing severe pain!
The Ten Thousand Souls Banner was also violently turbulent.
Three figures emerged from the chaotic spatial turbulence and collapsed piles of bones like ghosts.
The leader was wearing a red robe, with a sinister face, and holding a long sword burning with flames. He was the Red Flame Swordsman——
Ancestor Burning Heart!
He stared greedily at the Ten Thousand Soul Banner in Yin Jiuyou's hand and licked his lips: "What a rich source of soul evil!
There is still a trace of the king's soul!
